claims.rationale: No conversion to people; later arrivals need separate treatment. English rendering (ours): "where Bernadotte had arrived with a battalion and the dragoon brigade from Pr. Holland, and Drouet with 2 infantry regiments from Saalfeld, so that including Pacthod’s Mohrungen garrison 9 battalions and 11 squadrons were present."

citations.quote: wo zur Zeit der M. Bernadotte mit einem Bataillon und der Dragoner-Brigade von Pr. Holland, der General Drouet mit 2 Infanterie-Regimentern von Saalfeld angelangt waren, so daß mit der Besatzung von Mohrungen, unter dem General Pacthod, 9 Bat. und 11 Schwadr. anwesend waren.

claims.value: Side B: the French bulletin estimates the opposing division as apparently 12,000 men at the encounter.
claims.rationale: Opposing estimate, not a Russian return; differs from Bodart’s 9,000. English rendering (ours): "The enemy division appeared to be 12,000 strong."

citations.quote: La division ennemie paraissait forte de 12,000 hommes.

claims.value: The earlier French bulletin places Rivaud with Ponte-Corvo and says Dupont arrived too late to participate.
claims.rationale: Retained against the later bulletin; not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "advanced with Rivaud’s division to meet the enemy" English rendering (ours): "Dupont’s division arrived as the combat was ending and could not participate."

citations.quote: se porta, avec la division Rivaud, au-devant de l’ennemi
La division Dupont arriva au moment où le combat finissait et ne put y prendre part.

claims.value: The next French bulletin places Drouet with Ponte-Corvo and describes Dupont’s flank attack; it names Pahlen and Galitzin as Russian commanders.
claims.rationale: Bodart and Höpfner name Markow; the French title Ponte-Corvo and the Bernadotte spelling are associated by this shared engagement description, not a resolved global person registry. English rendering (ours): "Marshal Prince of Ponte-Corvo arrived at Mohrungen with Drouet’s division" English rendering (ours): "At that very moment Dupont emerged from the Holland road with the 32nd and 96th regiments. He turned the enemy’s right." English rendering (ours): "Counts Pahlen and Galitzin commanded the Russians."

citations.quote: Le maréchal prince de Ponte-Corvo arriva à Mohrungen avec la division Drouet
A l’instant même le général Dupont débouchait de la route de Holland avec les 32e et 96e régiments. Il tourna la droite de l’ennemi.
Les comtes Pahlen et Galitzin commandaient les Russes.

claims.value: Höpfner says Bernadotte collected available troops and ordered the attack; Markow halted his advance and formed on heights after learning the marshal was present.
